{{Quote|It is more like a virtual intelligence than a holographic recording. Master Tharis developed it.''"<br />"''You are too generous, Master Vandar. It was Master Arca who implemented my sketches.|Vandar Tokare and Tharis Orne, two gatekeepers of the Noetikon of Science|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Noetikons''' were treasured relics of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and were special [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] designed to sift through the vast storehouse of knowledge within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]]. The internal workings of the Noetikons were designed by [[Tharis Orne]], though it was [[Arca Jeth]] who made use of Orne's designs to create them.

==Overview==
Created during the early history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], each of the Noetikons were infused with the wisdom, knowledge and personality of three of the greatest [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] in the Order. When accessed, an individual consulted with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] representation of these Masters who went through their great knowledge to help those Jedi that came to them. There were at least three different Noetikons which consisted of the [[Noetikon of Science]], [[Noetikon of Light]] and the [[Noetikon of Secrets]].<ref name="TOR" />

Safeguarded within the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]], the Noetikons were stored within a terminal within a chamber of the Archives. Whether accessed individually or collectively, the knowledge possessed within the device was unfathomable by a single mind. During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] at the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], the Temple was destroyed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Order was forced to abandon the pile of rubble which had served as their home for centuries. As the Jedi left Coruscant, the Noetikons fell into the hands of [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] scavengers, members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Justicars' Brigade|Justicars]] who took the relics deep into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] returned to Coruscant and sought out the Noetikons in order to cure Master [[Yuon Par]] from a [[Dark Plague|strange sickness]]. Collecting the artifacts and returning them to the Temple, the Consular was able to learn the technique necessary to cure the illness from the collective wisdom of the Noetikons before a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] destroyed the terminal.<ref name="TOR" />

After witnessing the threat of the [[Children of the Emperor]], [[the Barsen'thor]] sought knowledge on a potential army to combat the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Through consultation with the collective three Noetikons, the combined Jedi Masters discerned legends from the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] that spoke of an alien army imprisoned on a distant world. This led to the [[Consular]] journeying to a Rakatan monument on Hoth to find the coordinates to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that held the sleeping [[Esh-kha]].<ref name="TOR" />

The Noetikons were taken to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] but after the [[Assault on Tython|Assault]] by the Sith Empire, they were returned to Coruscant.
